name: The Tacet Hollow

detectability.signature: Null return in every gravity band simultaneously; a silent hole in the mass map of the sector

proximity: All gravitational reference points vanish from navigation systems at once
Instruments begin reading zero mass for the ship itself
contact: Thrusters become the only means of orientation as inertia behaves strangely
Loose objects and crew drift free mid-corridor without warning
prolonged_exposure: Bones and inner ears degrade without any gravitational frame of reference
Vessels emerge permanently unable to resynchronize with standard nav beacons

phenomena: Navigation instruments returning contradictory mass readings at the boundary
Objects accelerating without thrust upon exiting the null region
Zero-mass readings for vessels crossing the threshold
hazards: Hull breach from gravitational shear at the boundary
known_incidents: The destroyer Steady Measure entered during pursuit in 2308 and emerged ninety degrees off course, drifting powerless for nineteen days with nineteen hours of air remaining.
description: There is nothing to see: stars behind it, stars before it, and a sphere half an astronomical unit wide in which the galaxy forgets to pull. Instruments render it as a hole in every gravity map at once, its edges sharp as a rest in a musical score. Light crosses it unchanged, which is precisely how ships get lost inside it.

The Hollow wanders the sector on no schedule instruments can fix, erasing mass readings at its boundary and reducing incoming vessels to the only moving things in the universe. Thrusters work; intuition does not. Exiting can be violent, as the hull remembers gravity all at once along a shear line.

The destroyer Steady Measure entered during pursuit in 2308 and emerged ninety degrees off course, powerless, nineteen days short of air; the court-martial transcript is required reading at two naval academies. Cartographers mark its recent positions in pencil only. Theoretical physicists would trade careers for one week of clean data inside, and several have.

Current doctrine treats the Hollow as weather: track it, respect it, never assume it holds still. Stations near its historical path maintain spin-based backup navigation and drilled freefall drills. Somewhere inside, presumably, is everything it has swallowed, and none of it is talking.
